headline: West Liberty's unbeaten start ends at Frostburg State
dek: West Liberty had won all four of their matches before they went to Frostburg State, and they leave with their first defeat of the season. Frostburg State, who inflicted it, are still without a defeat of their own.
displaced_by: results night: Frostburg State end West Liberty's perfect start, a first defeat after four wins
